@@note: Simplified Chinese, made for the device's UI from the mobile app's (mstream_music, lib/l10n/app_zh.arb, master bdb174e) and the terminal player's (mstream-terminal-player, locales/zh.yml, main b89ad0a) translations where they had the text or the term (both GPL-3.0, the same author's; their words and register are kept: informal 你, 曲目 for a track counted with 首, 曲库 for the Library, 队列, 艺术家, 专辑, 群星, and a space between Latin letters or digits and hanzi; their fullwidth punctuation is written as the ASCII signs, 、 and 。, which is what the device can draw), and translated by a Fable agent (Claude) otherwise. A machine translation, reviewed by a second Fable agent, not yet by a native speaker: a review as a pull request on this file is welcome. The rooms the notes give are those the texts were fitted to (42356b7); the layout fixes since gave most buttons and pills 2-4 px more and Small when their font doesn't fit, so a few of the apps' words a note set aside would fit now (docs/I18N.md, phase 3, lists them for a native review).
